scripts.load-chrome: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('manifest.chrome.json')){fs.copyFileSync('manifest.chrome.json','manifest.json'); console.log('Chrome manifest loaded')} else {console.log('manifest.chrome.json not found - run npm install first')}"
scripts.load-firefox: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('manifest.chrome.json')){fs.copyFileSync('manifest.json','manifest.chrome.json'); console.log('Chrome manifest backed up')}; fs.copyFileSync('manifest.firefox.json','manifest.json'); console.log('Firefox manifest loaded')"
scripts.restore-chrome: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('manifest.chrome.json')){fs.copyFileSync('manifest.chrome.json','manifest.json'); console.log('Chrome manifest restored')} else {console.log('manifest.chrome.json not found')}"
